notice.title: 1386 Public Notice Dated: 03.12.2021 JOINT CSIR-UGC NET EXAMINATION JUNE-2021 Read More

registration_open.evidence: Duration of Online registration for Joint CSIR- UGC NET Examination June-2021 03 December 2021 to 02 January, 2022 (upto 11:50 pm) Last Date of successful fee transaction

registration_deadline.evidence: Duration of Online registration for Joint CSIR- UGC NET Examination June-2021 03 December 2021 to 02 January, 2022 (upto 11:50 pm) Last Date of successful fee transaction

clauses.text: Candidates who desire to appear in Joint CSIR-UGC NET Examination June-2021 may apply online on the website https://csirnet.nta.nic.in, www.nta.ac.in and details of Course Code, Eligibility Criteria, Pattern of Question Paper etc. are available on the Information Bulletin
Before applying for Joint CSIR-UGC NET Examination June-2021, candidates are advised to check the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the Information Bulletin
